concept: Taking responsibility for your own reactions and choices, not just your actions' direct outcomes
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is provoked or frustrated by someone else's behavior and must decide how to respond
exercise.branching_choice: Student's response shapes whether the situation escalates or resolves
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up distinguishing what the other person did from how the student chose to respond

assessment.success_marker: student separates the other person's behavior from their own chosen response
